We are happy to hear you had a positive experience at Coral Way Animal Clinic! We value your input and encourage you to let us know more details about your experience with us.

Hi Roxana,
We are happy to hear you had a positive experience at Coral Way Animal Clinic! We value your input and encourage you to let us know more details about your experience with us.

Hi Jose,
We are happy to hear you had a positive experience at Coral Way Animal Clinic! We value your input and encourage you to let us know more details about your experience with us.

Hello, We would like to apologize for your recent experience and sorry to hear you were less than satisfied. We pride ourselves on our service and the high-quality standards we maintain and would like to make things right. Please reach out to us at (817) 642-5032 to discuss what occurred and how we might make it up to you.

Do not come here! I brought my Labrador here for an X-ray to see if what she swallowed which was a mango pit was still inside her, but there wasn’t anything, they lied to me and said there was, so that they could charge me $5,000 to perform a surgery she didn’t even need!! Just so they can make money off a lie these people don’t care about your animals just money don’t come here, I went to another vet and they told me based on the X-ray alone there was nothing, they gave me medicine and she felt better after two days. Disgusting people.

“I am so grateful to Coral Way Animal Clinic for the excellent care we received. From the moment we arrived, they treated my dog ​​with so much love, patience, and professionalism. They explained everything very well and made me feel reassured knowing he was in good hands. It's clear they love what they do and truly care about animals. Thank you so much for all the care and attention. I would definitely recommend this clinic and would return with my pet.” 🐶❤️🐾
They saved my dog. Thank you so much.

Please, please avoid taking your pet to this vet. I took my sick dog and it was all about money and nothing about caring for my pet. No emotions, it felt cold. They're super pricey. The did three different blood tests to my dog, they did an x-ray that the doctor didn't even know how to read. He finally diagnosed my dog with a severe gastritis and maybe something wrong with his pancreas. My dog was a little dehydrated from vomiting and so he ordered an injection to stop the vomiting, and an IV to replenish his fluids. For this my dog would have to stay until Monday and I was a bit skeptical about it because I've never left my dog at a vet overnight before but I really wanted him to feel better so agreed to it. The vet then administered two acupuncture injections on the top of the head where the ears start, claiming that it was to calm him down. They took him in, we paid for the visit   and left. So I literally live two blocks from this vet and as soon as I walked in, they called me to go back to the vet. When I walked in my dog was already dead on the bed and them, acting as if they were applying CPR to my dog but he was gone. They claimed that he had a heart attack and died. This was 5 minutes after I left him in their care. No explanation as to how this happened, just a very cold, he died and he moved his shoulders up like saying I don't know. I think what happened was that the assistant kept using a towel kind of choking my dog so that he wouldn't bite the vet and since my dog was already sick, weak, and also very scared, he couldn't breathe well and died. That vet sat at his station and acted as if nothing happened. Cold and indifferent. This was dog who I adored and loved with all my heart and this has been devastating for us. I will make it my life mission to stop anyone from raking their pet to this slaughter. I should have known because that same day, three other animals have died in the hands of these people.

This clinic is the best!! They took care of my Coco when he had some very scary health problems. Thanks to their expertise, compassion, and excellent communication, he's back to his energetic self. Bring your furry friends here for the best care!

I want to start off by saying I was really skeptical about bringing my dog here because of the mixed reviews, but I decided to take my chances—and I'm so glad I did.
I had previously taken my pup to another clinic where they not only gave me a ridiculously high estimate for his surgery, but they also failed to notice he had a large lipoma on his chest.
Oscar was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything to us thoroughly, which immediately gave me confidence that Jack was in good hands. Even though Jack's recovery took a little longer than expected, thanks to Oscar and his amazing staff, the surgery was a complete success.
A few weeks later, Jack developed a limp. Instead of immediately recommending X-rays, the doctor suggested trying anti-inflammatory medication first. Thankfully, that was exactly what Jack needed, and he made a full recovery. I truly believe that many other clinics would have jumped straight to expensive tests, but this team put Jack's well-being ahead of unnecessary costs.
They've earned a loyal customer, and I'll absolutely be bringing my other two pups here whenever they need care.
Every veterinary clinic will have both positive and negative reviews, but sometimes you have to experience it for yourself instead of relying solely on what you read online. That's exactly what I did, and I'm so thankful I did because I found a veterinary team I trust.
I highly recommend them!

This clinic should be shut down. They let my dog ​​die due to medical negligence. They admitted him Saturday afternoon, and he was alone Saturday night and Sunday. We called all day, and no one answered. We went to the clinic on Sunday, and no one answered the door. We only heard our dog barking around 2 pm. Supposedly, the vet arrived at 12 pm. I don't understand how a clinic admits an animal without supervision. I just see the clinic's hours, and they're listed as 9 am to 4 pm. On Monday at 8 am, they called to say he had died around 6 am, and they only notified us at 8 am. How awful! Be careful with your pets at that clinic. Don't leave them there, don't take them. He's not the first one to die alone.

I am deeply disappointed with the care and communication I received from this clinic. My young dog was admitted for hospitalization after I paid the required deposit in full.

I expected professional monitoring and regular updates, but that did not happen. My calls went unanswered, and I was left without information until I was informed that my dog had died.

As a pet owner, I trusted this clinic with a member of my family. Instead, I was left with unanswered questions and an explanation that did not give me confidence that my concerns were taken seriously.

I sincerely hope no other family experiences this level of distress and lack of communication.

Highly recommended clinic. The doctor and his staff are very attentive and considerate, especially regarding prices. I've been taking my dog ​​there since January. They are very professional and animal lovers.

The staff and doctor are very friendly, kind, and caring. They were extremely patient and took the time to answer all my questions and make me feel comfortable as a pet parent. I especially appreciated that they chose the most effective way to treat my cat without recommending unnecessary exams or procedures. They focus on properly treating the problem instead of offering only a temporary solution that requires you to keep coming back. Their prices are also much more reasonable compared to other clinics. I’m very happy with my experience and highly recommend Coral Way Animal Clinic!

Im still shocked at my experience here. I’ve never been screamed at by a vet or doctor in my life. This man was so extremely rude and unprofessional, raising his voice at me. I didn’t want to do chest x rays for my cat, I just wanted to see what the bloodwork showed first. When I asked him to calm down and not raise his voice at me, he runs to the back to tell his techs to cancel the bloodwork. WHICH WAS ALREADY DRAWN. So my cat went through this stress for no reason. This vet should not be in practice I’m so confused by the good reviews. I’m also still so confused by what happened.. don’t understand why he got so upset. The only positive was the vet techs, they were really nice and professional. Luckily I started recorded when i noticed him getting aggressive so I’ll see where I can report this incident. I feel so bad for my cat who went through this stress for no reason. This place is just awful.

We called to see how much it would be to spay our dog . The receptionist on the phone said it would be 95 dollars. So we went there there today for first visit to see about getting her spayed and other medical checkups. We asked multiple times about the price points while there.
She said it would be 95 for spay. Then a doctor comes and say that the spaying will be 1700 . A big waste of our time. If you’re looking to get your dogged spayed it would be better to go to ASPCA Community Veterinary clinic for way better prices and aren’t interested in making a massive profit on your pet. Next time, don’t waste our time and just tell us the price over the phone before we even commit to walking through the door.

This is by far the best veterinary clinic I’ve ever been to! The entire staff is incredibly kind, compassionate, and genuinely dedicated to every animal that walks through the door. The doctor is not only wonderful and funny but truly went above and beyond for my cat. I can't recommend them enough!"

I am so grateful this clinic exists. I brought my cat in for diarrhea concerns - and they discovered an access on her back. They removed it that same day, checked in with me while she at home healing, and saw me with very little wait time when I returned for follow ups. The bill was so reasonable and I often felt they tried to find me the best price. The doctor and staff here know what they’re doing and I genuinely feel that he and the team approach cat health with compassion and competence. Thank you for healing my girl!!
The doctors are very patient, friendly, and do an excellent job treating pets, and they also have a cat with soft fur that lives at the clinic.

I took my kitten in thinking they'd just give me some cream and that's it... but they did their job, they took x-rays and operated on him. He was in pretty bad shape; his paws weren't visible to the naked eye. Thank you all so much, excellent! I highly recommend them.
The best... doctors and team in general, thank you so much for your kindness.

I brought my (16) year old  2 pounds chihuahua with a uterus infection and the doctor operated her immediately and safe her life. He is wonderful the staff was great! I am blessed to have come to him when I did. Thanks to that my baby it’s doing great!!!

Great experience and well attended. My French bulldog had an abcess on his cheek and they attended him with care and persistence. Recommended me the best treatment to give him, as well as all the medication was given that was needed.

I honestly cannot recommend this veterinary clinic enough.
This is not the first time I bring my little dog here — I’ve been coming to them for over a year now, and they have literally saved her life three times.

My dog called Uma, is 15 years old, blind, and has gone through three surgeries here. Every single time, the entire team has been incredibly professional, caring, honest, and compassionate. They always treated her with so much love and attention, and every surgery went very well.

What I truly love is that this clinic feels like a family. It’s run by a father and daughter, and you can genuinely feel the warmth and dedication they put into their work. The clinic is always extremely clean, organized, and professional.

This was also the first place where I ever felt comfortable leaving my dog overnight, and they took amazing care of her.

Considering we are in Miami, their prices are honestly very fair and reasonable, and I deeply appreciate how transparent and honest they are. Another huge plus is that they speak Spanish, English, and Italian, which made communication so much easier for me.

Today, my little girl looks like she recovered 10 years of life, and for that I will always be grateful.

Thank you so much to the entire team for everything you do 💕

I’m writing this review on behalf of my best friend’s dog, Freeda, who honestly feels like my own dog at this point. We took her to Coral Way Animal Clinic for what we initially thought was an ingrown hair removal, but it turned out to be two small cysts on her back. Both cysts were removed the same day quickly, professionally, and with genuine care.

What really stood out to me was how honest and fair this clinic was. Unlike many places in Miami that immediately try to push unnecessary blood work, fasting, endless add-ons, and expensive procedures, they handled the situation based on what Freeda actually needed, not on how much money they could make. Their pricing was extremely fair, especially compared to other clinics we contacted beforehand.

The staff treated Freeda with so much patience and love. They even did a courtesy acupuncture treatment behind her ears to help relax her before the procedure, which I thought was incredibly thoughtful. She had mild anesthesia that made her sleepy and a little wobbly for the rest of the day, but she recovered beautifully and was already up walking around shortly after.

The procedure itself was very clean and simple. Since both cysts were close together on her back, they shaved the area neatly, made two small incisions, cauterized everything properly, and even included an antibiotic injection in the price, so there was no need for extra medications, ointments, or stressful aftercare.

Most importantly, Freeda is doing great!

From now on, this is Freeda’s vet in Miami. It’s refreshing to find a clinic that prioritizes the well-being of the animal instead of turning every visit into an unnecessary financial burden for pet owners. Highly recommend Coral Way Animal Clinic.

I brought my cat here for his first visit today because his longtime vet is now too far, and he gets car sick during long drives. This clinic had great reviews, so I decided to give them a try. He was seen for a general checkup and a suspected ear infection.

During the visit, they presented me with a list of recommended services totaling nearly $1,100. To be fair, they did review the breakdown of costs with me, but many of the charges felt expensive for a routine visit. As I was not prepared to pay that level of money for a first visit at a new vet, I ultimately chose to proceed only with my cat’s routine vaccines and the ear flush.

What concerned me most was how my cat was handled. I have had cats my entire life, and not once have I seen a cat handled this way. My cat is 13 years old, blind in one eye, and has neurological issues, yet he is very docile and did not appear to require that level of restraint. They grabbed him by the scruff when removing him from his carrier, again when taking his temperature, and then once more when they returned him from the back after performing his ear flush.

Scruffing may have been common practice decades ago, but current guidance generally discourages using that method on adult cats because it can cause pain, fear, and unnecessary stress. That last time is when I made a comment and asked if they needed to hold him like that. The response I received felt dismissive — they reacted as if they did not understand my concern, responding with something along the lines of “like what?” which made it seem as though my partner and I were overreacting.

Additionally, the overall condition of the office did not feel well maintained, and there was an unpleasant smell in the room. I was also there for nearly two hours, and I do not believe I ever saw a veterinarian. Typically, a doctor will introduce themselves as such, and no introduction like that was ever made. Another concern was the lack of basic customer interaction: no one introduced themselves, and there was very little effort to make us feel welcome - no one even smiled.

The staff were polite, but not friendly. I recognize that many people have had positive experiences here, but my visit felt very different, and it did not meet the standard of care and professionalism I was expecting. Based on my experience, I would not recommend bringing cats here.

Some reviews are written with logic… others are written from the heart. This is one of them.

Coming to Coral Way Animal Clinic with a pet who needs complex surgery is filled with fear, uncertainty, and hope. My English bulldog Kiara had to undergo surgery to correct a chronic tail pocket condition along with her spay. From the very first visit, we felt we were not alone.

Dr. Oscar has been simply outstanding. Not only is he highly skilled, confident, and thorough in every explanation, but he is also deeply empathetic, warm, and charismatic. He remembers you despite seeing so many patients every day. He listens, he reassures, and he always looks for real solutions. The way he treats Kiara — with patience, respect, and genuine care — gave us peace of mind from day one.

Her recovery has not been easy. Because of the amount of fatty tissue she has, her healing process has been slower than expected. I want to clearly state that the complications were not due to poor surgical management or lack of care, but rather her individual healing condition. Even so, Dr. Oscar and his team have been present every step of the way: laser therapy sessions to stimulate healing, frequent wound care, careful follow-ups, and when necessary, a second anesthesia to re-suture internally and place a Penrose drain. Their dedication has truly touched our hearts.

What deserves special recognition is the entire clinic staff. From the moment you walk in, you feel a warm and welcoming environment. The technicians and assistants remember Kiara, call her by name, praise her, comfort her, and shower her with gentle affection. Despite attending to countless patients daily, they never make you feel like just another appointment. That level of compassion is rare and incredibly meaningful.

The clinic itself is spotless. The cleanliness is evident everywhere. Everything is organized, well-maintained, and equipped with modern, sophisticated surgical and monitoring technology that provides tremendous peace of mind when your pet needs anesthesia or delicate procedures. The atmosphere is calm, safe, and truly comforting.

Another aspect that deeply impressed us is their integrity. After paying for the surgery, all additional follow-ups, wound care, procedures, and monitoring have been provided at no extra cost. We have only paid for the additional medications needed. This speaks volumes about their ethics, vocation, and true commitment to their patients.

During vulnerable moments, when you fear for your pet’s health, finding professionals who not only know what they are doing but also support you emotionally is priceless.

Today we can confidently say that Kiara is in the best hands thanks to Dr. Oscar and the wonderful team at Coral Way Animal Clinic.

We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking high-level veterinary care, advanced technology, genuine compassion, and a team that truly loves what they do.

Thank you for caring for our sweet girl as if she were your own. We will never forget everything you have don

Absolutely loved our experience here. I brought both of my sisters cats here and  came in for vaccines and boosters, and from the moment we walked in, we felt taken care of.
Jorge and Kitty Meow greeted us and brought us to our room right away. Jorge explained everything step by step while getting the meds ready, which I really appreciated because I’m new to this whole “cat auntie” life and had… a lot of questions.
(We come from a long line of dog people, okay? 😅)
Dr. Leo came in, did a full physical exam, went over the meds we discussed, and gave me some great recommendations for flea prevention in the yard. Super patient, super knowledgeable.
Overall, an amazing experience. The staff was kind, thorough, and genuinely cared about my fur babies.
Thank you all so much! 🐾💛
Love this place, my dog gets multiple treatments here and the stsff and Doctor are very welcoming and professional

We are incredibly grateful for the care we received during an emergency situation. Although our regular doctor was unexpectedly ill and unable to see us, the clinic ensured that our dog was still treated promptly and responsibly.

An associate went above and beyond by helping us outside of normal office hours, and did so with real professionalism and kindness — without charging us for that assistance. The quick intervention made a genuine difference, and we felt supported rather than rushed or pressured.

Moments like this matter. We deeply appreciate the dedication and compassion shown, and wanted to say thank you publicly. Thank you!

Absolutely recommend this clinic. They are very empathetic and patient with you and your pet. I brought in my dog with a severe blockage and the Dr. performed a successful surgery same day. I'm very thankful and will continue to have my dog's care here.

I'll start by saying how happy I am to have found this clinic. The service was very quick, the doctor is a wonderful person who loves what he does and has a lot of empathy for animals. He ordered exactly the right tests, no more and no less, which is very hard to find in other clinics that order tons of tests that ultimately weren't necessary, just to make money. The staff is very well-trained, patient, and professional. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, and they've gained another client! 🙏

Dr. Paez-Castro saved my dog’s life. She is a 12 year old German Shepard. Despite her aggressiveness, the vet team at this clinic did everything they could to make her feel safe and comfortable. She had a horrible skin infection in addition to a tumor on her front paw. They shaved her, bathed her with antibacterial soap, and extracted the tumor. Eventually the leg had to be amputate and Dr. Paez performed the amputation free of charge. My dog is now doing much better and walking perfectly on 3 legs. The doctor and the entire team are extremely caring and would do anything to see that a pet is healthy and happy.

Today I took Olivia my dog  for a check-up. I found a super professional and caring doctor who made Olivia feel very safe. The staff there were also all very attentive. I recommend them to anyone looking for safety and professional expertise.
Excellent attention the doc Oscar s the best. He help my Dog Yogui a lot with his leg cancer.
Dr. Paez is amazing. He shows compassion and treat the patients with such care! Also great with pets owners. I highly recommend this clinic and this awesome doctor.

I’ve taken both my dogs to this clinic and have been happy every time I’ve come here. Dr. Oscar and all of the staff are attentive, amiable, and have gone above and beyond helping my two girls. He does a great job of explaining procedures, explaining the costs before paying, and providing information throughout the process.

One of my dogs is very anxious but he was able to accommodate us and still provide great care and services. I really appreciate all of the effort him and the staff put into helping us.

The best animal clinic in Florida!!! They undoubtedly treated my dog ​​like the king he is and helped him improve from the very first moment. Everyone at the clinic is an expert and knows the best techniques to help animals feel better. High technology and lots of love. I am so grateful to Coral Way Animal Clinic!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in all of South Florida. I live over an hour away, and yet I always take my dog ​​there because the team at Coral Way Animal Clinic is simply exceptional: professional, compassionate, and deeply committed to each patient.

My English bulldog had congenital hip dysplasia that required four surgeries in two months, and I can say with complete gratitude that every day, every visit, and every call was handled with the same care and dedication.

The medical team not only cared for my dog ​​with impeccable attention but also treated us like family, providing us with confidence, empathy, and support during the most difficult times.

Thank you to Dr. Paez and his entire team for restoring our bulldog's quality of life and for always treating us like we were part of their own family.

Thank you to Dr. Paez and his entire team for giving our bulldog back his quality of life and for always treating us like we were part of their own family. 💛 If I could give them more than five stars, I would give them all the stars in the sky.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
**Coral Way Animal Clinic is simply exceptional!**

Taking my dog ​​here was the best decision I could have made. The veterinarians are true professionals, with a perfect combination of experience, knowledge, and a caring approach. You can tell they love what they do and that their priority is the well-being of every animal.

My dog ​​needed hip and knee surgery, which had me very worried. From the very first moment, the Coral Way Animal Clinic team explained every detail of the procedure, the pre- and post-operative care, and they gave me enormous peace of mind. The surgery was a complete success, and the most incredible thing is that **my dog ​​started walking almost immediately**.

The treatments they offer are cutting-edge, and it's clear they stay up-to-date with the latest veterinary techniques and technologies. But beyond the technical aspects, what I value most is the **dedication and love** with which they treated my little one throughout the entire process.

If I could, I'd give them **10 stars!** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone who wants the best possible care for their pet.

--
Most importantly, they are always there for you and your pet when you need them.

We went in for my 14 year old chihuahua unable to relieve himself. He didn’t even growl at the puppy in the waiting room, and if you know chihuahua’s, you know this is a sign of a major problem. Thankfully Dr Oscar was able to run some tests, then stay late and perform emergency surgery that same day. Now our little grandpa is doing much better, all healed up, and back to his grumpy self growling and barking at other dogs. I’ve had this dog since I was 19. He is family and it meant the world to me and my husband that the doctor took the time to help us ensure he’s still with us and hopefully will be for many more years to come. We will be taking all of our pets here in the future due to the care and kindness we were shown our first day walking through those doors. I can confidently recommend this business to anyone else who has pets in need of care.

We are happy to hear you had a positive experience at Coral Way Animal Clinic! We value your input and encourage you to let us know more details about your experience with us.

I am so grateful to everyone at the clinic; they are the best. They operated on Luna, my dog, for spinal surgery, and the doctor and the team were excellent, like family. They truly are the best. Now Luna is walking, and we are all so happy, the children too. Excellent service, excellent doctor, excellent everyone. Thank you.

Edit after business response-

I spent most of my day yesterday contacting a few different vets in the area who advised me I really should have had a second opinion before using your services. Again, it is my error to have not done proper research and to have sent my father to have done what should have been something I handled myself but as it was Father's Day weekend, I made plans that I could not cancel to as it would have made an already difficult situation harder on my son. Lesson learned.

Original-

I should have done better research but I suppose what's done is done. We moved back to Miami after living in Broward and wanted to find a closer vet. Reviews seemed great and was happy it was right down the street.
My father brought my cat in as she seemed to have an upset stomach  and had vomited at least 8 times along with some diarrhea, a few days prior. She hadn't thrown up in over 24 hours but I had already made the appointment so decided to keep it just in case. He called me while in the office and told me they wanted to charge a little over $600 to do x-rays and other tests to make sure it isn't something serious. This cat was my late husbands and my son would be devastated if something happened to her. I told him if it was necessary, to do it. I guess the doctor heard the desperation in my voice and decided to take advantage. Talks of keeping her in the clinic for observation, possibly overnight, etc. $600 turned into $900 plus a credit card surcharge fee. It's my mistake. I should have been there as I would have said absolutely not and would have taken her elsewhere, but unfortunately had plans with my son that could not be broken. The cherry on top is that every time I give her the medicine they prescribed, she vomits it all up. I decided to quit and not give her the 2nd dose yesterday and she's fine. Hasn't thrown up, no more diarrhea, is happy as a clam and back to snuggling up with my kid. I have been to countless vets in the past and have never felt so dissatisfied and overcharged. The last time I paid $900 for a vet bill, it was for emergency after hours surgery for my dog when she cut her leg on a piece of broken glass.

If you do decide to try this vet, make sure you keep your wits about you and at least price check with other offices. I for one will never set foot here, or recommend any of my pet friends to this vet.
Great place with very knowledgeable doctors and assistants. I totally recommend it. They really care about the well being of your pet.

Dr. Paez and staff are absolutely amazing. Coming to the office is like going to a family's home. Dr. Paez (Oscar) is straight and to the point. Your pet will receive what they need and with genuino care and affection.

Coral Way Animal Clinic is the best  veterinarian in Miami period and it shows. I founded them on googe make an appointment and looked my dog. The minute I get there was second to none, the staff loving and caring. Oscar the vet. Has over 4 decades of experience not to mention  that he is one of the e few vets in Miami that has an especially with exotic animals, and that is another level. They treat my dog like there own, all the process was with transparency due to there systems and process within and very affordable. Belive me I have paid ten of thousands on vets before. Definetlly may Vet from now on, I will recommend them to friends and family.
Thank Yoy Coral Way animal Clicnic.
My baby had surgery and is pain-free. You are the best, thank you!
The best!
My kitten had surgery and I'm so happy! Thank you!
This was my second visit to take my recently adopted puppy ❤️ there were very gentle with her and they explained me all I needed to know for her wellness and care! Thank you!

Best vet in Miami! Dr. Oscar is very knowledgeable and kind. He and his clinic staff go out of their way to make both you and your pet as comfortable as possible. I couldn’t recommend them even more!!

Staff was generally nice but i was not told that when i got there for my appointment  that the doctor had not even arrived yet (he later told me its his day off and he doesnt arrive until later than my appointment was even scheduled), by the time he met me for my appointment an hour late  my cat was extremely irritated. I would not go here if your animal does not like to be at the vet and if you are concerned about extended wait times. I would also avoid this vet if your pet does not do well around cats as they have a cat that roams the vet office.

I can confidently say that this vet office is the best in Miami! Dr. Paez Castro is outstanding, he seamlessly combines eastern and western medicine, which shows his approach to pet care. Every member of his staff is absolutely wonderful and incredibly knowledgeable, making every visit a positive experience. I've never had to worry about leaving my pets in their care. In fact, I collaborate with his clinic for many of my foster pets, and I trust them completely.

This is an excellent family-run business where your pets will be loved and embraced. You can rest assured that any health issues will be handled with the utmost care by Dr. Castro and his dedicated team. Highly recommend!

This animal clinic is top-notch! The facility is spotless, and the service is incredibly fast. They even take great care of turtles Samy, which is rare. Oscar is amazing—he was attentive, knowledgeable, and truly cared about my turtle’s well-being. Highly recommend! Here the before and after of Sammy.
Thank you John for the review !
